gateway_api_keys_subject_check.name: gateway_api_keys_subject_check
gateway_api_keys_subject_check.value:
(
        "gateway_api_keys"."subject_mode" = 'fixed_user'
        AND "gateway_api_keys"."platform_user_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "gateway_api_keys"."service_client_id" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "gateway_api_keys"."subject_mode" = 'canonical_subject'
        AND "gateway_api_keys"."platform_user_id" IS NULL
        AND "gateway_api_keys"."service_client_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND length(btrim("gateway_api_keys"."service_client_id")) > 0
      )

story_workspace_stories_artifact_identit.name: story_workspace_stories_artifact_identity_uidx
story_workspace_stories_artifact_identit.where: "story_workspace_stories"."artifact_source_type" IS NOT NULL AND "story_workspace_stories"."source_project_id" IS NOT NULL

subscription_payment_intents_renewal_bin.name: subscription_payment_intents_renewal_binding_check
subscription_payment_intents_renewal_bin.value: ("subscription_payment_intents"."operation" = 'initial_activation' AND "subscription_payment_intents"."expected_subscription_version" IS NULL AND "subscription_payment_intents"."expected_period_end" IS NULL) OR ("subscription_payment_intents"."operation" = 'renewal' AND "subscription_payment_intents"."subscription_id" IS NOT NULL AND "subscription_payment_intents"."expected_subscription_version" >= 1 AND "subscription_payment_intents"."expected_period_end" IS NOT NULL)

subscription_entitlements_limits_check.name: subscription_entitlements_limits_check
subscription_entitlements_limits_check.value: ("subscription_plan_entitlements"."daily_token_limit" IS NULL OR "subscription_plan_entitlements"."daily_token_limit" >= 0) AND ("subscription_plan_entitlements"."monthly_token_limit" IS NULL OR "subscription_plan_entitlements"."monthly_token_limit" >= 0) AND ("subscription_plan_entitlements"."storage_bytes_limit" IS NULL OR "subscription_plan_entitlements"."storage_bytes_limit" >= 0)

subscription_token_ledger_transition_che.name: subscription_token_ledger_transition_check
subscription_token_ledger_transition_che.value:
(
        "subscription_token_ledger_entries"."entry_type" = 'reserve'
        AND "subscription_token_ledger_entries"."available_after_tokens" = "subscription_token_ledger_entries"."available_before_tokens" - "subscription_token_ledger_entries"."amount_tokens"
        AND "subscription_token_ledger_entries"."reserved_after_tokens" = "subscription_token_ledger_entries"."reserved_before_tokens" + "subscription_token_ledger_entries"."amount_tokens"
        AND "subscription_token_ledger_entries"."consumed_after_tokens" = "subscription_token_ledger_entries"."consumed_before_tokens"
      ) OR (
        "subscription_token_ledger_entries"."entry_type" = 'capture'
        AND "subscription_token_ledger_entries"."consumed_after_tokens" = "subscription_token_ledger_entries"."consumed_before_tokens" + "subscription_token_ledger_entries"."amount_tokens"
        AND "subscription_token_ledger_entries"."reserved_after_tokens" <= "subscription_token_ledger_entries"."reserved_before_tokens"
        AND "subscription_token_ledger_entries"."available_after_tokens" <= "subscription_token_ledger_entries"."available_before_tokens"
      ) OR (
        "subscription_token_ledger_entries"."entry_type" = 'release'
        AND "subscription_token_ledger_entries"."available_after_tokens" = "subscription_token_ledger_entries"."available_before_tokens" + "subscription_token_ledger_entries"."amount_tokens"
        AND "subscription_token_ledger_entries"."reserved_after_tokens" = "subscription_token_ledger_entries"."reserved_before_tokens" - "subscription_token_ledger_entries"."amount_tokens"
        AND "subscription_token_ledger_entries"."consumed_after_tokens" = "subscription_token_ledger_entries"."consumed_before_tokens"
      ) OR (
        "subscription_token_ledger_entries"."entry_type" IN ('refund', 'reversal')
        AND "subscription_token_ledger_entries"."available_after_tokens" = "subscription_token_ledger_entries"."available_before_tokens" + "subscription_token_ledger_entries"."amount_tokens"
        AND "subscription_token_ledger_entries"."reserved_after_tokens" = "subscription_token_ledger_entries"."reserved_before_tokens"
        AND "subscription_token_ledger_entries"."consumed_after_tokens" = "subscription_token_ledger_entries"."consumed_before_tokens" - "subscription_token_ledger_entries"."amount_tokens"
      )

subscription_allowances_balance_check.name: subscription_allowances_balance_check
subscription_allowances_balance_check.value: "subscription_usage_allowances"."granted_tokens" >= 0 AND "subscription_usage_allowances"."bonus_granted_tokens" >= 0 AND "subscription_usage_allowances"."reserved_tokens" >= 0 AND "subscription_usage_allowances"."consumed_tokens" >= 0 AND "subscription_usage_allowances"."reserved_tokens" + "subscription_usage_allowances"."consumed_tokens" <= "subscription_usage_allowances"."granted_tokens" + "subscription_usage_allowances"."bonus_granted_tokens" AND "subscription_usage_allowances"."granted_microusd" >= 0 AND "subscription_usage_allowances"."reserved_microusd" >= 0 AND "subscription_usage_allowances"."consumed_microusd" >= 0 AND "subscription_usage_allowances"."reserved_microusd" + "subscription_usage_allowances"."consumed_microusd" <= "subscription_usage_allowances"."granted_microusd"
